cspFinding.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
cspFinding.plainEnglishCause: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected. Without a CSP, the application is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and rogue script injection.
cspFinding.technicalDetails: Content-Security-Policy header is absent on https://www.fsf.org

fixSteps.instruction: Add the Content-Security-Policy header directive in your Nginx server block.
fixSteps.codeSnippet:
# /etc/nginx/sites-available/your-site
add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https:;" always;

hstsFinding.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
hstsFinding.plainEnglishCause: The server does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS. Users communicating over insecure networks are vulnerable to SSL stripping and man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks.
hstsFinding.technicalDetails: Strict-Transport-Security header is absent on https://www.fsf.org

fixSteps.instruction: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to your HTTPS server block in Nginx.

serverLeakFinding.title: Server Identity Information Leaked
serverLeakFinding.plainEnglishCause: The server is disclosing its underlying software and version number via the 'Server' or 'X-Powered-By' response header. This aids attackers in footprinting known CVE vulnerabilities.
serverLeakFinding.technicalDetails: Server header leaked on https://www.fsf.org: nginx

fixSteps.instruction: Disable server version numbers in the http block of /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.
